REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - APRIL 14, 2016 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
APRIL 14, 2016, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by City Clerk Vida Barone.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by the Girls Pee Wee Division All Start Basketball
  Team from the City’s Youth Basketball League.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Carol Chen
  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki
  Mayor/Chair George Ray

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  Proclamations were presented as follows:

  Virginia Lorca (Life Saving Rescue)

  Hedy Harrison-Anduha, Ron Hill, Susan McCormick, Joe Santy, and Tony Velardi (12th
  Annual Orchid Show). A PowerPoint Presentation was displayed.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Bob Quinlan inquired regarding the City’s procedures for investigations.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by
  one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated April 14, 2016
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the Register
  of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated April 14, 2016 in the total amount of
  $7,366,811.56 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  April 14, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 5

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos
  Redevelopment Agency dated April 14, 2016 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the Register
  of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency dated
  April 14, 2016 in the total amount of $2,842,405.00 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The
  motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of March
  24, 2016 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of March 24, 2016
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7D.  Approval of the Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending February 29, 2016
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending February 29, 2016 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7E.  Award of Bid No. 1242-16, Printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts
  2016-17 Season Brochure (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to award Bid No. 1242-
  16 for the printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts 2016-2017 Season
  Brochure to Advantage Mailing, Inc. in the amount of $118,530.50. In the event issues
  of non-performance arise, the project would be removed from Advantage Mailing, Inc.
  and taken to the next lowest bidder to ensure the City’s printing deadline, quality
  standards and specifications are met. This process would be repeated as necessary in
  order of the lowest bid to the highest (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  April 14, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 5

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7F.  Adopt Ordinance No. 1003, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING
  SECTION 20.30.470 AND SECTION 22.22.700 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE
  RELATING TO THE REGULATION OF SYNTHETIC TURF, HEREIN REFERENCED AS
  DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2016-2 (COUNCIL).*

  *Waiver of reading in full adopted at introduction of Ordinance on March 24, 2016.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to waive further reading
  of and adopt Ordinance No. 1003, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  AMENDING SECTION 20.30.470 AND SECTION 22.22.700 OF THE CERRITOS
  MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO THE REGULATION OF SYNTHETIC TURF,
  HEREIN REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2016-2
  (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for citywide bus stop
  improvements, Bid No. 1237-16 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Director of Public Works. A
  PowerPoint Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Paul Bellenbaum inquired whether electronic schedule board or real time transit
  trackers could be placed inside the bus shelters.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public
  comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Solanki, to:

  1. Award a contract in the amount of $454,046.00 for Citywide Bus Stop
  Improvements, Bid No. 1237-16, to ND Construction Company, Inc. and reject all
  other bids; and
  2. Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to execute any project-related
  change orders (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  April 14, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 5

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  Review and consideration of approval for expenditure of funds for the
  replacement, removal, and repair of a 24-inch butterfly valve located at 166th
  Street and Eric Avenue in the City of Artesia (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vince Brar, Senior Assistant City Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to award a contract to
  W.A. Rasic Construction in the amount of $64,242.00 for the installation of the new 24-
  inch butterfly valve and reject all other bids (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for installation of playground
  surfacing at Jacob Park, East and West, Project No. 10074, Bid No. 1243-16
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Director of Public Works.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Pulido, to:

  1. Award a contract in the amount of $170,800 for CDBG-Funded Playground
  Resurfacing Improvements, Project No. 10074, Bid No. 1243-16, to WCCR
  Construction and reject all other bids; and
  2. Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to execute any project-related change
  orders. (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal Legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Council/Agency Members Pulido, Edwards, and Chen,
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Solanki, and Mayor/Chair Ray.

12.  Closed Session

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT: City Attorney Mark Steres reported the City

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 8:49 p.m.
